url.label: Address to check
url.description: An http(s) address, or demo to see every state.

label.label: Name on BUSY Bar
label.description: Up to 8 letters, like API or SHOP.

field.label: Status field
field.description: Path into the JSON, like status.indicator; empty: HTTP only.

healthy.label: Values that mean healthy
healthy.description: Comma-separated. Any other value counts as down.
healthy.default: none, ok, up, passing, success, operational, green, true

slow_ms.label: Slow above, ms
slow_ms.description: A slower healthy answer turns amber. 0 turns it off.

header.label: Request header
header.description: Optional Name: value, for an address that wants a token.

sound.label: Sound when down
sound.description: A sound, once, when a healthy address goes down.
